root_cause.text: The vulnerability arises because the Rust PWM `new` function fails to call `pwmchip_put` to release the reference obtained from `pwmchip_alloc` when `__pinned_init` initialization fails.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that "If __pinned_init() were to fail, the allocated pwm_chip would currently leak because the error path returns without calling pwmchip_put", and the patch addresses this by wrapping the `__pinned_init` call with `.inspect_err(|_| { ... bindings::pwmchip_put(c_chip_ptr) })` to ensure cleanup on error.
